milestones.description: Reset released, first clock cycle. top_in_a is sampled into in_a_history[0]. valid_pipe starts filling.
Second clock cycle. top_in_a from step 1 moves to in_a_history[1]. valid_pipe continues.
Third clock cycle. top_in_a from step 1 becomes past_3_in_a. check_en becomes 1. Condition for p_noshift_bug assertion is met.
Verification Target: The p_noshift_bug assertion fails because b_out does not equal past_3_in_a + 1.
valid_pipe second bit set, top_in_a history being recorded
valid_pipe fully filled (check_en becomes 1), past_3_in_a captures a value > BRANCH_THRESHOLD from 3 cycles ago
Verification Target: b_out does not equal the expected shifted value based on past_3_in_a
